BMW source decoder checks current ATSH6F1 and received DID, not positive service, original requested DID, exact source ECU or response address.

Inspected BLE4 notify/send/shared-dispatch path populates text rather than the BMW binary vector, which the shared queue clears. No dependable BLE fallback is established.
CAN receive path logs but does not reject unexpected CF sequence; final CF padding not trimmed; single-frame declared length is not bounded by actual received DLC.
Concrete car-factory activation and deployed configuration were not recovered; no whole-application runtime/reliability or safe-cadence claim.
